# Temple Scroll Column 36 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 36 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**36:1** You shall designate places to the east of the temple city, separated from it, for those afflicted with skin diseases.

**36:2** They shall dwell there in isolation and shall not enter the temple city.

**36:3** You shall designate places to the north of the temple city for all who suffer from discharges: both the man with a chronic discharge and the man with a seminal emission.

**36:4** They shall remain there until the day of their purification; they shall not enter the temple city while in their state of impurity.

**36:5** You shall designate a place to the west of the temple city for women during the days of their menstrual impurity.

**36:6** They shall not enter My temple city, nor shall they defile My temple city in which I dwell.

**36:7** For I, the LORD, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel forever and always.

**36:8** Every person who is purified from a skin disease shall bring the offering of his purification before entering the temple city.

**36:9** The priest shall examine him outside the city; if the disease has healed, the priest shall declare him clean.

**36:10** On the eighth day he shall present his guilt offering, his sin offering, and his burnt offering in accordance with the prescribed instruction.

**36:11** When a man with a discharge finds that his discharge has ceased, he shall count seven days for his purification.

**36:12** On the eighth day he shall wash his garments and immerse his body in flowing water; then he shall be clean.

**36:13** Thereafter he may enter the temple city; he shall bring his offering to the LORD — two turtledoves or two young pigeons: one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering.

**36:14** The priest shall effect atonement for him before the LORD on account of his discharge; and he shall be clean.

**36:15** The children of Israel shall keep themselves apart from all impurity; they shall not defile the land in which I dwell.

**36:16** For I, the LORD, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel; the land itself shall be holy.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 36 establishes three quarantine zones outside the temple city, organized by impurity type: skin diseases to the east, bodily discharges to the north, menstrual impurity to the west. Purification rituals follow Leviticus 13-15. The theological motivation is divine indwelling.*
